problem:
Find all real eigenvalues of the matrix
$E=[\begin{aligned}2 & 8 \\ -2 & -6\end{aligned}].$
worked_solution:
Let's start by writing the matrix $E-\lambda I:$
﻿﻿﻿

$$
E-\lambda I=[\begin{aligned}2-\lambda  & 8 \\ -2 & -6-\lambda \end{aligned}].
$$

Now, let's find and solve the characteristic equation $det(E-\lambda I)=0:$

$$
\begin{aligned}det(E-\lambda I) & =0 \\ |\begin{aligned}2-\lambda  & 8 \\ -2 & -6-\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (2-\lambda )(-6-\lambda )-(-2)\cdot 8 & =0 \\ -12-2\lambda +6\lambda +{\lambda }^{2}+16 & =0 \\ {\lambda }^{2}+4\lambda +4 & =0 \\ (\lambda +2)^{2} & =0.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the matrix $E$ has only one eigenvalue $\lambda =-2,$ which is a double root of the characteristic equation.
